description:
Shift hue, saturation, and lightness on the active layer via Image > Adjustments > Hue/Saturation. Values are applied once to pixels, not stored as an adjustment layer.

Use when: a direct color shift on the current layer is enough.
Do NOT use when: the change must stay editable — use photoshop_adjust_vibrance or photoshop_adjust_curves.
Do NOT use when: the user wants a cinematic grade — use photoshop_recipe_apply_color_grade.

Returns: the hue, saturation, and lightness that were applied.
Preconditions: active document and active layer. Text and Smart Objects are rasterized first, and a non-Normal blend mode is reset to Normal. Side effects: destructive pixel edit, one history step. Reversible with photoshop_undo.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

name: photoshop_adjust_hue_saturation
